description: A light-colored T‑shirt lies on a pink-covered surface in front of a large white pillow/backrest. The left hand and right hand grasp and pull the shirt open to flatten it, then each hand folds a side inward and smooths it; next they bring the bottom portion up over the top, and finally the right hand tucks and compresses the folded bundle while the left hand steadies it, leaving the shirt neatly folded.
